\section{Introduction}
\label{sec:intro}

% A comment the extracts drop.
Edge caches serve requests close to the user, and a miss costs a round trip to the origin~\cite{Doe2029}.
When request patterns shift, a cache that keeps only recent items misses often.

\textbf{Approach.} \examplesys{} predicts the next request from the last ten and fetches it early.
It needs no change to the client.

This paper makes three contributions:
\begin{itemize}
\item A predictor that ranks candidate requests by how often they follow each other (Section~\ref{sec:design}).
\item A fetch policy that bounds the bandwidth spent on wrong guesses.
\item An evaluation on a synthetic trace (Section~\ref{sec:discussion}).
\end{itemize}
